# Suresh Kumar Mukhiya, PhD

> Suresh Kumar Mukhiya is a Tech Lead and secure software architect based in Bergen, Norway. His professional focus includes application security, secure software architecture, API security, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, cloud security, and AI-assisted development security.

- [Application Security](https://skmukhiya.com.np/security): Security capabilities, verification approach, technology focus, and contact information.
- [Architecture](https://skmukhiya.com.np/): Professional profile and architecture focus.
- [Technology Stack](https://skmukhiya.com.np/stack): Technologies used across applications, cloud, data, and security.
- [Research](https://skmukhiya.com.np/research): Publications, books, and doctoral research.
- [Career Trajectory](https://skmukhiya.com.np/trajectory): Professional experience.
- [AppSec Blog](https://skmukhiya.com.np/blogs): Application-security and software-supply-chain briefs.
- [Contact](https://skmukhiya.com.np/connect): Contact and collaboration.

## Security focus

- Secure architecture and threat modelling
- API security, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID
- Secure SDLC and OWASP ASVS security requirements
- SBOM, dependency governance, and software supply-chain security
- Security-focused review for Rust, Python, FastAPI, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft SQL Server
- Azure cloud and platform security
- Security for AI-assisted development and agentic systems
